captions.detailed: A compact, low-profile pancake camera lens with a shallow cylindrical barrel. It features a wide focus ring with vertical ridged grips around its middle section and a thinner, notched manual aperture ring near the rear. The focus ring and the aperture ring both rotate continuously and coaxially around the central barrel axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a compact pancake lens model with a shallow barrel, a ridged focus ring, and a rear aperture ring. Ensure both rings are configured with continuous rotational joints along the central axis.
captions.factory: The model is constructed with three parts: a main barrel, a focus ring, and an aperture ring. The barrel is created using a main cylinder with a central wedge cutout to serve as an alignment indicator. The focus ring is a hollowed cylinder decorated with radial rectangular notches patterned around its outer perimeter. The aperture ring is similarly created with a smaller height and fewer radial notches. Continuous rotational joints (articulations) are established along the Z-axis to connect the focus ring and the aperture ring to the main barrel.
